full_judgment: 5. It has been further argued that the High Court Division committed an error of law in holding that summons of Title Suit No. 182 of 1962 was not served upon the plaintiff respondent No. 1 as defendant of that suit although there was a definite finding of the Appellate Court that summons were served upon her and, as such, judgment passed by the High Court Division is not a proper judgment of reversal. It is also argued that the learned Single Judge also failed to consider the question of limitation involved in a suit for setting aside the compromise decree in the backdrop of legal presumption that all official acts were done correctly, that the plaintiff failed to produce any evidence of possession of the suit land for more than 41 (forty-one) years.
